control.objective: Test whether 4h trade intensity works as a FILTER on the existing long-only strategy: skip entries whose 4h trade-intensity percentile (trades vs the trailing 20-bar average) is above a threshold. Sweep thresholds (no filter / p90 / p75 / p50), report trades kept, net R/t with 95% CI, and gross R/t, split by regime (2023, 2024, 2025-26, ALL). The signal to test is NEGATIVE: high intensity predicted LOWER forward returns (non-overlapping IC -0.160, z=-1.90), so the filter should REMOVE high-intensity entries.

blackboard.repo_purpose: Long-only spot crypto trading bot (Kraken) + an honest research pipeline. Live trading is OFF by default (LIVE_TRADING=true to enable) and must stay off: the strategy measures net-negative.
blackboard.known_findings: See ROADMAP.md. Settled with real numbers, do NOT re-test: the swing entry is statistically indistinguishable from random (8,203 trades); gross-of-cost expectancy ~0 so cheaper fills cannot rescue it; exit-model and stop-placement sweeps both negative; the simple daily strategy is beta not alpha (indistinguishable from random entries passing the same MA20 gate).
blackboard.live_signal: CLOSED. Trade intensity was re-tested on 11,195 independent non-overlapping samples (20 pairs, 2023-2026) after the Executor correctly established that trade COUNT is available for every pair, not just BTC/ETH/SOL/2026. Result: IC -0.0027, z=-0.29, p=0.751 pooled, with the sign FLIPPING positive in 2024. The earlier -0.160 (z=-1.90) on 142 samples was noise. No order-flow feature is both statistically real and economically tradeable: imbalance is real at 15m (p=0.003) but worth 1-6% of cost; cum-imbalance is noise (p=0.309); intensity is zero; big-print is nothing.
blackboard.data_correction: Executor turn found the assignment's stated data limitation was factually wrong and corrected it before running: 'trades data is BTC/ETH/SOL+2026-only' is FALSE for the `trades` column itself -- Kraken's OHLCVT archive format carries a real trades-count column and data.js's ingestKrakenOHLCVT parses it (verified empirically: LTCUSD, archive-ingested only, has 1,293,046 of 1,293,047 bars with trades > 0). The limitation IS correct for buyVol/sellVol/maxTrade, which genuinely are zeroed on archive-ingested bars -- so aggressor-imbalance/big-print features really are BTC/ETH/SOL+2026-only, but trade-COUNT-based features (intensity) are available for all 20 watchlist pairs across full 2023-2026 history. Use the full watchlist for any future trades-count-only feature; keep the 3-pair/2026 restriction only for buyVol/sellVol/maxTrade-dependent features.
